name: コヒーレンス分析
description: 測定します text 一貫性 and logical flow consistency.
useCase: Detecting AI text through unnaturally smooth 一貫性
mechanism: 測定します sequential similarity 間の content segments. AI生成の text often maintains unnaturally high 一貫性 throughout, while 人間のテキスト naturally varies.
source: Zellers et al. (2019) - Defending Against Neural Fake News, NeurIPS
parameters: ウィンドウサイズ: 適応型, Quantization: 8-64 levels, Metrics: エントロピー, CV, 相関
strengths:
- Effective for detecting AI生成の text
- Language-agnostic 統計的 approach
- Works with any text length
- Low computational overhead
limitations:
- Less effective on edited or paraphrased AI text
- Domain-specific content may trigger 誤検出
- Short texts provide less reliable signals
- Performance varies にわたる 文体s

references.title: Zellers et al. (2019) - Defending Against Neural Fake News, NeurIPS
Bakhtin, A. et al. (2019). Real or Fake? Learning to Discriminate Machine from Human Generated Text. arXiv.
